src/catalog-intent-resolver.ts.name: Finding a handler napplet
src/catalog-intent-resolver.ts.description: Chooses an installed, verified napplet that can handle a request, applies the user's choices and hands the work over.

src/intent-service.ts.name: Intents service
src/intent-service.ts.description: Answers napplet requests to hand work to another napplet, passing them to the host's resolver with the sender's verified identity.

src/intent-types.ts.name: Intent shapes
src/intent-types.ts.description: Re-exports the shared intent record shapes from the napplet protocol package.

src/manifest-intent-catalog.ts.name: Manifest to catalog entry
src/manifest-intent-catalog.ts.description: Turns what a signed napplet manifest says it can handle into an entry in the intent catalog.
